docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-08-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF AYOOB, TANNER IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT KRUTIKOVA, NADEZHDA PLAINTIFF FAILED TO SUSTAIN BURDEN CONSIDERING ALL ORAL AND DOCUMENTATION EVIDENCE. NOTA BENE: PLAINTIFF ASSERTS OTHERS COULD BE LIABLE AND NO COMPETENT EVIDENCE DEFENDANT (WHO WAS ALSO ROBBED) IS LIABLE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
REMARK:RETURN MAIL MAR-09-2023 NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT MAIL TO DEFENDAT(NADEZHDA KRUTIKOVA)(ENVOLOPE MARKED:RETURN TO SENDER P.O.BOX CLOSED)

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-08-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-08-2023 BY JUDGE RONALD E. QUIDACHAY. PLAINTIFF TANNER AYOOB IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS HEATHER AYOOB (MOM). DEFENDANT NADEZHDA KRUTIKOVA IS PRESENT AND IS ASSISTED BY RUSSIAN COURT RUSSIAN INTERPRETER TATIANA IACONA #301252. BEFORE INTERPRETER'S ARRIVAL, COURT FINDS DEFENDANT SPEAK AND UNDERSTAND ENGLISH TO PROCEED TO TRIAL WITHOUT NEEDING INTERPRETER ASSISTANCE. INTERPRETER WAS ALLOWED TO PROVIDE ASSISTANCE TO DEFENDANT FOR TRANSLATION DURING THE PROCEEDING. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. VISITING JUDGE: RONALD E. QUIDACHAY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY AYOOB, TANNER AS TO DEFENDANT KRUTIKOVA, NADEZHDA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-08-2023 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
REQUEST PENDING TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF AYOOB, TANNER
